The same Shekalim chapter has bar Bivin and biRabbi Bun in different passages.
The checked Yerushalmi reads Gamliel Zuga questioning Yose biRabbi Bun. Heilprin’s Gamliel article expressly gives both variants. Preserve this article’s spelling.
The checked same-chapter Huna attribution uses Yose biRabbi Bun and calls the authority Rav Huna.
The checked Shmuel attribution with bar Bivin is at 3:2:8. Chapter 5 numbering or a second locus remains to be reconciled.
